business_objective: Coordinate makeup activities for students who miss scheduled learning sessions and close each case after all assigned work is accepted.

stakeholder_statements.text: When an enrolled student misses a scheduled learning session, the attendance clerk records the missed session.
The teacher lists the makeup activities for that missed session and records a due date.
I mark each makeup activity submitted and may add a submission note.
The teacher reviews each submitted activity and records it as accepted or needing revision.
The academic coordinator closes the absence case only after every makeup activity is accepted. Changing course grades is outside this project.

business_objective: Investigate customer reports of unrecognized debit mandates and suspend mandates confirmed as unrecognized.

stakeholder_statements.text: An account holder reports a debit mandate they do not recognize and identifies the merchant shown on the account.
The service officer confirms whether the mandate is active and records the account holder's explanation. The acceptable supporting evidence has not been defined.
The mandate reviewer examines the report and records whether the mandate is recognized or unrecognized.
When the reviewer records it as unrecognized, the payment operations clerk suspends the mandate and records the suspension date.
The service officer sends the recorded outcome to the account holder, but the delivery channel is undecided. Refund investigation and merchant contact are outside this project.

business_objective: Review ingredient changes for allergen impact and ensure service staff acknowledge updated ingredient notices.

stakeholder_statements.text: The recipe chef records a proposed ingredient change and identifies the affected menu item.
The food safety reviewer records which allergens are introduced or removed. The allergen category list is not finalized.
The food safety reviewer either accepts the change or returns it with comments.
After acceptance, the menu publisher updates the staff-facing ingredient notice, and service staff record that they have read it.
A change may not be marked complete until the notice is updated and acknowledged by the assigned service staff. Customer pricing and supplier purchasing are outside this work.

business_objective: Review requests to correct insured-asset descriptions and control when accepted corrections become effective.

stakeholder_statements.text: A policyholder requests a correction to an insured asset description and provides the proposed corrected detail.
The policy service agent checks whether the request includes supporting evidence and returns incomplete requests. The required evidence depends on the correction type, but that list is not settled.
The underwriting reviewer accepts or rejects the requested correction and records whether a premium review is required.
For an accepted correction, the policy records clerk updates the asset description and records the effective date.

If a premium review is required, the request remains open until that review is recorded, but no role has been assigned to perform it. Collecting premium payments and issuing refunds are outside this project.

business_objective: Review workplace schedule accommodation requests using completeness, occupational, operational, and final-decision inputs while preserving an unresolved medical-disclosure conflict.

stakeholder_statements.text: An employee submits a workplace schedule accommodation request, states the requested adjustment, and explains how the current schedule affects their work.
The HR case officer checks whether the request is complete and routes health-related requests to an occupational advisor. The required request information is not finalized.
The occupational advisor records functional work restrictions. The advisor says the manager should see the restrictions but not the employee's medical details.
The line manager records the operational impact of the requested adjustment and says the supporting medical details must be visible to the manager before they can comment.

The decision officer records an approved or declined outcome after the HR review, manager input, and occupational advice when applicable. An approved arrangement must have a review date, but nobody has decided who sets it. The meeting also drifted into complaints about the break-room kettle.
